scope: AI scoring throughput in production before and after #249 (parallel batches, no duplicate backfill calls)
method: scored = rise in items.total minus fall in items.pending_score between two /api/pipeline readings

before.calls_per_run: 12 scoring calls in sequence plus up to 12 tmt and 12 title calls, which during a backlog re-judged unscored items

after.note: one run of 8 rounds started 21:35:10 and the next 21:55:11; the second interval includes a run boundary and its refresh_derived step

follow_up: #251: one waiting job per schedule and 5 rounds per run, because 20-minute runs outlasted the 15-minute tick
